method: Isolated Playwright Chromium 1440×1000 and WebKit 390×844 contexts on the existing loopback preview. Only the 100ms browser interval was suppressed inside those contexts; natural AI and growth advanced through the actual development bridge in one-second fixed-game-time increments. Pure engine modules supplied targeted edge-case checks. No user browser, source, frozen fixture, dependency or service was changed by QC.
limitations: This is fixed-game-time runtime verification, not five minutes of human interaction or a balance/enjoyment assessment.
Physical iPhone Brave, actual device toolbars/safe areas, and screen-reader sessions are not covered.
Root owns protected command verification, broader viewport/accessibility inspection and final receipt.
